meta.title: Delete account
meta.description: How to delete your Soulwick account yourself: in the game, or here with a deletion code from the game, right away and for good.

title: Delete account
lead: You delete your Soulwick account yourself, right away and without a request: in the game, or here with a deletion code from the game.

inGame.title: Right in the game
inGame.text: Open Account in the game and choose “Delete account”. After one more question, your account is gone.

steps.code: In the game, under Account, get a deletion code for the website. It has 8 characters, is valid for {minutes} minutes and works only once.
steps.enter: Enter your player name and the code here.
steps.confirm: Check that the account shown is yours, then delete it for good.

gone.account: Your account and your player name
gone.logins: The links to Steam, Google Play or your device that you sign in with

kept.runs: Your runs stay without your name so the leaderboards of your guild and teammates remain correct. Your own leaderboard places disappear.
kept.device: The save on your device. Single player needs no account, so you can just keep playing.

noAccess.title: Can't get into the game any more?
noAccess.mail: Then write to us at <mail></mail>. Tell us your player name, the platform you played on (for example Steam or Android) and roughly when you last played.
noAccess.deadline: We then delete your account within the period stated in the <link>privacy policy</link>.
noAccess.subject: Soulwick account deletion
noAccess.body:
Player name:
Platform (e.g. Steam, Android):
Last played (roughly):
noAccess.fallback: Then write to us using the contact details in the <link>imprint</link>. Tell us your player name, the platform and roughly when you last played.

rights: What other rights you have is explained in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

form.title: Find your account
form.intro: Player name and deletion code from the game. Nothing is deleted yet.

playerName.label: Player name
playerName.hint: Exactly as the game shows it.

code.label: Deletion code
code.hint: Shown in the game under Account, valid for {minutes} minutes. Upper or lower case, spaces and dashes don't matter.

errors.title: That didn't work yet
errors.nameLength: The player name has {min} to {max} characters.
errors.codeFormat: The deletion code has exactly 8 letters and digits.

codeMismatch.title: No matching account found
codeMismatch.text: Player name and deletion code don't match, or the code has expired or was already used. Get a new code in the game under Account and try again. If you can't get into the game any more, <help>here's what to do</help>.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.text: Too many attempts came from your connection recently. Please try again in an hour.

unreachable.title: Server not reachable
unreachable.text: The server isn't answering right now. Your entries are still here; please try again in a moment.

rejected.title: Entry not accepted
rejected.text: The server didn't accept the entry. Check player name and code and try again.

confirmExpired.title: Please start over
confirmExpired.text: The confirmation took too long or was already used. Your account has not been deleted. Get a new deletion code in the game and enter it here.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.text: Nothing was deleted; your account stays as it is.

confirm.title: Is this your account?
confirm.intro: You have {minutes} minutes to confirm the deletion.

gone.account: Your account and your player name are deleted.
gone.logins: The links to Steam, Google Play or your device are removed.
gone.guild: {count, plural, one {Your membership in {guild} ends.} other {Your memberships in all # guilds end.}}
gone.founder: If you founded a guild, its oldest member takes over the lead. If you are the last person in it, the guild is disbanded.
gone.runs: {count, plural, =0 {You have no runs yet, so no leaderboard place disappears.} one {Your run stays without your name; your leaderboard place disappears.} other {Your # runs stay without your name; your leaderboard places disappear.}}

unreachable.title: Server not reachable
unreachable.text: Your account has not been deleted yet. Please try again in a moment.

rejected.title: Deletion not accepted
rejected.text: Your account has not been deleted yet. Please try again, or start over with a new deletion code.

done.title: Your account has been deleted.
done.device: The save on your device is not affected: single player needs no account, so you can keep playing.
